chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sukuni, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
"The ghurrah increases and decreases, but its value is five hundred dirhams."

key_terms.اَلْغُرَّةُ: the ghurrah; a legal compensation category mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.دِرْهَمٍ: dirhams; the monetary unit of valuation
key_terms.قِيمَتُهُ: its value; the assessed legal worth

ai.seo_question: What is the value of the ghurrah in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the ghurrah, indicating that although it may vary in some respects, its assessed value is fixed at five hundred dirhams. The report belongs to the jurisprudential rulings discussed under the chapter of pregnant women, fetuses, and related laws.
